caption: A row of paper lanterns hanging in a garden is lit one by one, and each glows as its candle is lit.

sa.check: A row of paper lanterns hangs in a garden.
Each glows as its candle is lit.
The lanterns are lit one by one, not all at once.

pc.expect: A lantern glows only after its candle is lit and lights the leaves nearest to it.
pc.fail: A lantern glows before it is lit; or stays dark after; or the leaves far away brighten more than the near ones.

pc.expect: The lanterns keep their number and each is lit once.
pc.fail: A lantern vanishes; or appears; or one glows in two places.
One goes out on its own; or flickers off and on; or dims as the next is lit.

pc.expect: The lanterns hang still and sway only if touched.
pc.fail: They swing wildly untouched; or float up; or one moves along the row.
One changes shape; or merges with its neighbour; or turns into another object.

pc.expect: The lanterns' colours and the garden stay the same.
pc.fail: A lantern changes colour; or the garden rearranges; or the string changes.

note: The hand is the minimal trigger; the person is not judged.
